checks.name: Core Prolog rule bundle
checks.selection_predicate: Every semantic rule-engine command and transition requires the core Prolog bundle.

exits.action: Restore the managed .agent/skills/iterative-planner/prolog/*.pl rule bundle, then rerun the semantic command.
Record a typed, approved, time-bounded entry in .agent/degraded_coverage_waivers.json.

checks.name: Canonical repository ontology facts
checks.selection_predicate: The semantic rule engine loads repository facts for every invariant or transition evaluation.

exits.action: Create or repair the required .agent/ontology/facts/*.yaml sources, then run node .agent/skills/iterative-planner/scripts/ontology_cli.mjs build.
Record a typed, approved, time-bounded entry in .agent/degraded_coverage_waivers.json.

checks.name: Project-specific Prolog rules
checks.selection_predicate: Selected only when prolog/project.pl exists in the host project.

exits.action: Repair the selected prolog/project.pl source so it loads under the reserved-predicate policy.
Record a typed, approved, time-bounded entry in .agent/degraded_coverage_waivers.json.

checks.name: Active-plan persisted ontology fallback
checks.selection_predicate: Only selected when no same-invocation transient ontology facts are available.
checks.reason: The authoritative transition path supplies transient facts; the on-disk file is a backward-compatible supplement and makes no independent coverage claim.

checks.name: Transition gate registry
checks.selection_predicate: Every transition requires the canonical gate registry.
checks.reason: Transition exits before evaluation when the registry or guide-first contract is unavailable.

checks.name: Transition health scanner
checks.selection_predicate: Selected by gates.json health_scan for quick or full health gates.
checks.reason: A missing or failed health scanner produces GATE-HLT-001 and blocks the transition.

checks.name: Transition health baseline
checks.selection_predicate: Selected for full health delta gates.
checks.reason: A missing baseline emits GATE-HLT-004 rather than claiming a clean delta.

checks.name: Persona audit configuration and packs
checks.selection_predicate: Selected whenever gates.json marks persona_audit compulsory.
checks.reason: Compulsory persona resolution emits stable GATE-PER failures when configured packs cannot load.

checks.name: Transition checklist source
checks.selection_predicate: Every registered transition selects its matching checklist.

exits.action: Restore the missing registered gate checklist under .agent/skills/iterative-planner/checklists and refresh its integrity baseline.
Record a typed, approved, time-bounded entry in .agent/degraded_coverage_waivers.json.

checks.name: Story registry coverage
checks.selection_predicate: Project health always evaluates story coverage.
checks.reason: Project health emits an explicit warning that story coverage is unknown.

checks.name: Project health analyzer configuration
checks.selection_predicate: Analyzer YAML files present in managed or project analyzer directories are selected for loading.

exits.action: Repair or restore the named analyzer YAML and rerun project health.
Record a typed, approved, time-bounded entry in .agent/degraded_coverage_waivers.json.

checks.name: Project health story-registry runner
checks.selection_predicate: Selected when a story registry exists and project health is asked to validate it.

exits.action: Record a typed, approved, time-bounded entry in .agent/degraded_coverage_waivers.json.

checks.name: Project health analyzer execution
checks.selection_predicate: A loaded and enabled analyzer is selected unless quick-mode or explicit enablement excludes it.
checks.reason: Runtime failures are emitted explicitly and the analyzer is excluded from analyzers_ran, preventing a count-based full-run claim.

checks.name: Suggestion engine
checks.selection_predicate: Selected only when the explicit suggestion_engine feature flag is enabled.
checks.reason: An explicit disabled flag means the capability was not selected and makes no coverage claim.

checks.name: Planning-only provenance subchecks
checks.selection_predicate: Selected only after the parent planning-only structural handoff is valid.
checks.reason: When the parent structure is invalid, its hard failure already prevents a proof claim; child provenance checks cannot create an independent result.
